*Combined RDF — cross-region monthly roll-up · August 2026*

ICT, Rawalpindi, Tanzania, Kenya, Moawin and Sindh side by side — the same numbers each region's own RDF shows, one thread. This is the monthly roll-up: August 2026 · Sat 01 Aug – Mon 31 Aug — every number is the whole of August, and every ▲/▼ compares it with July.

Thread ↓

*Every region at a glance.* Teachers on Rumi, % making lesson plans, % doing AI-coaching, lesson-plan rating, human observations this month, and observations per leader per day (per working day of the month). Every chip compares this month with last month. Each region uses its own denominator, so these match what each team sees in its own RDF — an automatic parity check asserts that equality before every send.

*Teach Well — % of teachers making lesson plans, by region.* Over the calendar weeks inside August, Monday to Sunday, the first and last of them partial — the same month every region's own monthly covers. The end label on each line is the month's figure (the scorecard number), and its chip compares this month with last month. Curves are smoothed with a monotone cubic, so the line cannot invent a dip that never happened; the dots are each week's actual value, and the month's figure sits on the end label.

*Improve — % of teachers doing AI-coaching, by region.* Over the calendar weeks inside August, Monday to Sunday, the first and last of them partial — the same month every region's own monthly covers. The end label on each line is the month's figure (the scorecard number), and its chip compares this month with last month.

*Improve — human observations per leader per day.* The HITL stream: a leader watches a class and scores it. Shown *per leader per day* rather than as a raw count, because the regions have very different team sizes (53 coaches in ICT, 12 deputy principals in Kenya) and a raw count would only ever say which region is biggest. The end label on each line is the month's figure (the scorecard number), and its chip compares this month with last month.

*One rubric, every region — how FICO is trending.* Every region's *AI-coach* recordings (a teacher recording their own class, which is the same act everywhere) scored against the same rubric by the same model, restricted to each region's canonical cohort — the same people every other panel counts. The end label on each line is the month's figure (the scorecard number), and its chip compares this month with last month. Every region on the card is sampled — a region with no line here has no scored recordings in the window, not a region we skipped. Full method, one page: <https://docs.google.com/document/d/1L-w9eeOSosPCszepuES1q-d5I5c_f0YWtYI9DWPJ2ps/edit|How the combined RDF compares regions>.

combined.closer: *A few notes.* Each region uses its OWN denominator so these match what each team sees in its own RDF: ICT = the 3611 registered primary teachers with a sector (ICT's own LP-panel denominator); Rawalpindi = its zone roster of 1068; Tanzania = the 45 canonical pilot people matched to Rumi (school leaders included, exactly as Tanzania's own sheet lists them); Kenya = the 60 canonical SHOFCO teachers; Moawin = the 454 registered org-moawin teachers, observed by cluster coordinators; Sindh = the 51 teachers STEDA nominated, 49 of them matched to Rumi by phone (the `region` column holds 800, sixteen times the roster, so it is not the filter). Sindh has no human observers yet — nobody has been set up to run /observe there, so its observer row reads "not enabled" rather than zero. How all of this is made comparable: <https://docs.google.com/document/d/1L-w9eeOSosPCszepuES1q-d5I5c_f0YWtYI9DWPJ2ps/edit|one-page method note>. — Rumi :)

ict.label: Islamabad (ICT)

panels.text:
*NIETE ICT — monthly roll-up · August 2026 · Sat 01 Aug – Mon 31 Aug*

The month's picture — registration, lesson plans, and coaching (observations + FICO). Everything below is this month — the whole of August; every ▲▼ is against last month. Thread ↓

*Registration — who's on NIETE, by sector*

3,611 primary teachers on the platform · 2,648 active this month (messaged Rumi, or made a lesson plan / did a session) · 2,169 made a lesson plan. Broken down by sector below — the bar shows how many of each sector's teachers were active this month.

*Teach Well — lesson plans by sector (primary teachers)*

20,291 lesson plans this month from 2,169 teachers. By sector this month: Urban-I 6347, Sihala 3903, Nilore 2891, Urban-II 2697, B.K 2368, Tarnol 2085.

*Teach Well — how teachers rated the lesson plans this month*

89% of the 5,841 teachers who rated a lesson plan this month found it useful (5217 👍, 624 👎).

What the 👎 teachers flagged most: wants an urdu version, lessons are too long, too complex / hard to follow. Full theme breakdown on the card.

*Teach Well — lesson-plan fidelity, by sector*

How faithfully lessons followed their OWN lesson plan — the % of the plan's prescribed moves the teacher actually executed. This month's average: coach-observed 38% · self-serve AI 33%. Navy = coach observations (dotted = each sector); gold = teachers' own AI-coach sessions.

_Only moves-graded sessions count — graded against the specific lesson plan this month: 392 of 1215 coach observations (32%) · 269 of 2037 AI sessions (13%). No lesson plan or unusable recording = excluded, never scored generically._

*Improve — AI-coach sessions by sector*

2,037 AI-coach sessions this month — a teacher records their own class and the AI coaches them. By sector this month: Urban-I 1020, Sihala 362, Urban-II 246, Tarnol 174, B.K 134, Nilore 101.

*Teach Well — teacher training, by course*

9,916 module completions by 373 primary teachers this month. This month the busiest course is *AI literacy* (1,644 completions by 98 teachers). Full course breakdown on the card.

*Teach Well — teacher training by sector and vendor*

9,916 module completions this month by vendor: Beacon House 5,145 · NIETE 4,325 · Oxbridge 446 — and since 1 Jul, 43,103 completions by 741 primary teachers (Beacon House 24,802 · NIETE 16,681 · Oxbridge 1,620). By sector, cumulative: B.K 17,998, Sihala 7,076, Tarnol 5,315, Urban-I 5,005, Nilore 3,921, Urban-II 3,788. The card splits each sector's bar by vendor.

*School-wise usage — every ICT school, by sector*

Worst first: the % of each school's primary teachers who used a lesson plan or did AI coaching this month.

*School-wise usage — by coach*

Each coach's assigned schools, worst first — the % is the school's teachers active this month; the reddest are where retention effort should go.

*Improve — coach observations by sector*

1,170 coach observations this month via /observe (a coach watches a class). Target is 63 per coach per month — 0 of 53 coaches hit it this month.

*Improve — FICO trend, by sector*

This month's average FICO — 60% all-Islamabad (▲ 1pt vs last month), across 17 observation days. The line is the day-by-day average; solid = all Islamabad, dotted = each sector; labels = each sector's month average. Lowest sector this month: Sihala (55%).

*Improve — FICO by sub-indicator, over time*

The four FICO sections tracked day-by-day. This month's averages: B Lesson-Plan Fidelity 63% (▼ 6pt vs last month), C High-Leverage Practices 60% (▼ 4pt vs last month), D Student Engagement 67% (▲ 4pt vs last month), F Subject Knowledge 61% (▲ 13pt vs last month). Lowest is *C High-Leverage Practices* (60%) — point coaching there; highest D Student Engagement (67%).

*Improve — FICO sections by sector*

Each sector's FICO section averages over this month's observations. The weakest cell right now: *High-Leverage Practices* in *Sihala* (55%) — that is where coaching points next.

*Enrolment — children on class rosters, by sector*

1,442 children are on class rosters — put there by a coach photographing the register with /roster (0) or by the teacher adding them to their own class (1,442) · +1,442 this month. By sector: Tarnol 599, Urban-I 417, B.K 208, Nilore 109, Sihala 101.

_160 more children have joined through a teacher's quiz link without being on any roster — not counted above._

*Quizzes — how the children did, by grade*

No quizzes sent this month.

📊 *Every quiz, its questions and objectives, with the teacher's PDF:* https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ui2vZioxTpDtptTHIoWOOg8fRyEBt_us_SzExUB8CUM
_Rewritten in place by every brief; saved filters keep working._

*Quizzes — how the children did, by subject*

No quizzes sent this month.

*Quizzes — objectives secured, grade × subject*

No quizzes sent this month.

• 20,291 lesson plans · 1,170 coach observations · 2,037 AI-coach sessions · 2,648 teachers active this month.

panels.text:
*Rawalpindi — routine data flow · monthly roll-up · August 2026 · Sat 01 Aug – Mon 31 Aug*

The whole picture in one thread — Teach Well (registration, lesson plans, ratings, HOTS training) and Improve (the at-home-learning loop, AI-coach, observations, HOTS), all by TM zone. Everything below is for this month — August as a whole, with every ▲/▼ against last month. Thread ↓

*Registration — who's on Rumi, by zone*

1,062 Rawalpindi teachers on Rumi · 352 active this month · 3 joined this month. Broken out by TM zone below, with Summaya (PM) on the overall line.

Every school here is mapped to its AEO and TM straight from <https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1uN3-hCG2OYVC6BFB8ONP3MgMxtf1rLZP9YOC8OfBmhw/edit|your own Rawalpindi School Coordinates sheet> — that document is the source of truth now, so a correction you make there shows up in the next brief.

_1 school is not in the sheet yet, so its teachers are still counted under the zone they had before — GGPS KOHALA SYEDAN (1). Adding them to the sheet moves them._

*Teach Well — lesson plans by zone*

1,324 lesson plans made this month, split by TM zone (every day of August). The solid line is all Rawalpindi; the dotted lines are each zone.

*Teach Well — how teachers rated the lesson plans*

96% of the 481 teachers who rated a lesson plan this month found it useful. Below the headline: the themes the 'not useful' teachers actually wrote.

*Teach Well — HOTS training progress*

Teachers who reached the rating step on each of the six fortnightly HOTS trainings (cumulative) — the ▲ chip on each bar is the growth since last month.

*Improve — the at-home-learning loop*

Teachers open a video and send it to class; children start the quiz and finish it. Each stage carries its growth since last month.

*Improve — AI-coach sessions by zone*

100 AI-coach sessions this month — a teacher records their own class and the AI coaches them. Split by TM zone (every day of August, the end labels are the month totals). 533 teachers have never tried it — Sohaib Danish 175, Iffat Akhtar 127, Tehniat Taqdees 117, Raheela 114. The live table's 'AI-coach ever' column names them, zone by zone.

*School-wise usage — where to point attention*

Every school grouped by TM zone, worst usage first — the % of a school's teachers who used a lesson plan or AI-coach this month. Redder = needs a nudge.

*Improve — AEO cards*

One card per AEO: the top bar is the % of their teachers active this month, then their lowest-usage schools, with a count of the rest doing better. This is where retention effort pays off.

*Improve — AEO observations by zone*

7 observations logged this month via /observe, by TM zone — target 2 a day per AEO — 42 for August's 21 working days.

*Improve — how HOTS is trending, by zone*

August's average HOTS from teachers' own AI-coach sessions — 53% all Rawalpindi (last month had no scored sessions), across 7 scored days. Solid = all Rawalpindi, dotted = each zone.

*Improve — HOTS by domain, over time*

The five HOTS domains (lesson planning, instructional strategies, student engagement, assessment & feedback, classroom environment) as daily-average lines — which is rising, which is slipping. The end labels are August's average per domain, each with its move against last month.

rwp.closer:
*In short — this month*

1,324 lesson plans · 100 AI-coach sessions · 7 observations · 352 teachers active this month, across 1,068 on the roster.

— Rumi :)

moawin.label: Moawin

panels.text:
*Moawin — routine data flow · monthly roll-up · August 2026 · Sat 01 Aug – Mon 31 Aug*

The recurring usage thread for the Moawin deployment — 454 teachers across 215 schools, organised by cluster-coordinator portfolio. Same panel family as the other regions. Thread ↓

*Registration — who's on Rumi, by cluster coordinator.* Every Moawin coordinator's portfolio (grouped Attock / Chakwal / Gilgit-Baltistan, straight from the school-pilot database) and how many teachers actually used Rumi this month. 60 teachers don't match any cluster yet — they're the 'no coordinator' row, not dropped.

*Teach Well — lesson plans.* The share of teachers making lesson plans AND the absolute count, each with its change chip. Bold navy = Moawin Punjab, bold gold = Gilgit-Baltistan; each thin dotted line is one coordinator's portfolio.
*Teach Well — how teachers rated the lesson plans.* The thumbs-up verdict with the change vs the previous month, plus what the 'not useful' teachers wrote.
*Teach Well — HOTS training progress.* Each of the six HOTS trainings: how many teachers have completed it (reached the rating step), with the growth chip. Newest training in gold.

*Improve — AI-coach sessions.* Teacher-initiated AI-coach — a teacher records their own class and the AI coaches them. Bold navy = Punjab, bold gold = Gilgit-Baltistan, dotted = coordinator portfolios.
*Improve — the at-home-learning loop.* Teachers open a video and send it to class; children start the quiz at home, and finish it — each stage with its growth chip.
*School-wise usage — where to point attention.* Every school with a registered teacher, grouped by cluster coordinator, worst first inside each group.
*Teacher-wise usage — the follow-up list.* Every registered teacher by coordinator and school: green = used Rumi this month, grey = needs a follow-up.
*Improve — coordinator observations vs the target.* Every cluster coordinator against the observation target (42 this month); gold ★ = went above it.
*Improve — how the HOTS score is trending.* The overall HOTS score from coordinator observations, with this month's average against last month's.

*Improve — HOTS by sub-indicator.* The five HOTS domains (Lesson Planning, Instructional Strategies, Student Engagement, Assessment & Feedback, Classroom Environment) — which is rising, which is slipping.

moawin.closer:
*A few notes.* Teachers = the 454 registered Moawin teachers; observers = the 19 cluster coordinators on the compliance roster, each mapped to their cluster's schools in the school-pilot database. 60 teachers don't match any cluster yet — flagged on the registration and teacher panels rather than dropped. If you count Moawin teachers with an org-wide query (e.g. the data MCP), you'll get a slightly bigger number — this brief deliberately leaves out the Akhuwat-program cohort and test rows; both counts are right, they're different cohorts. The score panels run on the HOTS-scored coordinator observations — small n so far, so read direction, not decimals. 37 observations were of teachers whose app profile isn't tagged to Moawin yet ((unnamed), Attiya, Azra, Ghulam, Iqra, Iram, Javeria, KASHMALA, Kainat, Muqaddas, Nageena, Neha, Raheela, Saira, Samiya, Sherin, Sidra, Sumayyah, Tahira, Zahida) — they count toward their coordinator, and fixing those tags will also link them to a school. This is the monthly roll-up: every number covers August in full, every change chip compares it with July, and the observation target is the daily one added up over August's working days. Gilgit-Baltistan appears as its own region across the panels — 359 Punjab + 95 GB teachers make up the 454 total. GB has no observation team yet, so it sits out the coordinator-observations panel; Moawin's POCs receive Punjab and GB separately.

— Rumi :)

kenya.label: Kenya (SHOFCO)

panels.text:
*Kenya (SHOFCO) — routine data flow · monthly roll-up · August 2026 · Sat 01 Aug – Mon 31 Aug*

The month in one thread — every number below is for August, and every ▲/▼ compares it with July. Per-day lines run across the whole month. 60 teachers across 5 schools. Thread ↓
*Registration — who's on Rumi, by school.* SHOFCO teachers registered in each school, and how many actually used Rumi this month, with each school's change vs last month.

*Teach Well — % of teachers making lesson plans, by school.* The headline metric this sprint — the share of each school's teachers generating LPs on each day of the month, and how many made at least one this month — all Kenya + each school, vs last month.

*Teach Well — how teachers rated the lesson plans.* The thumbs-up survey + the themes the 'not useful' teachers wrote (same grievance clustering as the other regions), with the useful-% compared to last month.

*Improve — AI-coach sessions, by school.* Teacher-initiated AI-coach is live — a teacher records their own class and the AI coaches them (0 sessions this month, 0 all-time). Per-day, all Kenya + each school.
*School-wise usage — where to point attention.* Every school by the % of its teachers active this month, vs last month, worst first.

*Improve — human observations (Deputy Principals).* The HITL stream — a Deputy Principal watches a class and scores it. This hasn't started yet; the DPs begin observing once adoption picks up (same role the AEOs play in Rawalpindi).
*Improve — how the AI-coach score is trending, by school.* The overall AI-coach score over time (TPAD + OECD) — all Kenya + each school, with this month shaded and its average vs last month.

*Improve — TPAD by sub-indicator, over time.* The four TPAD sub-indicators (Professional Knowledge, Content Delivery, Methods & Engagement, Management & Closure) — which is rising, which is slipping, this month shaded.

kenya.closer:
*A few notes.* Everything in this thread is for the calendar month, and every ▲/▼ compares with the previous calendar month; the per-day lines include weekends, which are quiet by design. It's school-centric because Kenya has no zone layer above the schools; the deputy principals are the per-school leaders but aren't in the DB yet, so the human-observations panel is a 'starting later' placeholder. Score panels run on the AI-coach sessions that carry a score (TPAD + OECD); a per-school trend line needs 2+ scored days, so a school with one session so far shows as a point.

— Rumi :)

Dafrosa 6, Kelvin 4, Lusungu 4, Maurine 4, Fadhila 3, Fidelis 3, Lina 2, Nyanjige 1.
